---
title: "Low Birth Weight Analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(gmodels)
```

```{r}
lbw_data <- read_excel('data/Low birth weight.xlsx')
lbw_data
```

```{r}

contingency_table  <- table(lbw_data$smoke, lbw_data$low)

contingency_table
```

```{r}
prop.table(contingency_table)
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    drop_na() %>% 
    group_by(smoke, low) %>% 
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count),
         percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion)) 
```

```{r}
library(gmodels)
CrossTable(lbw_data$smoke, lbw_data$low)
```
